The suffix هِ in فِيهِ is governed by فِي with يَخْتَلِفُونَ and resumes مَا.
لَمْ governs يَهْدِ in the jussive rhetorical question.
هُمْ is governed by لَ as the group to whom يَهْدِ becomes clear.
كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا begins the content clause governed by يَهْدِ.
كَمْ fills the object slot of أَهْلَكْنَا as the quantity destroyed.
قَبْلِهِمْ is governed by مِنْ as the temporal complement of أَهْلَكْنَا.
ٱلْقُرُونِ is governed by مِنَ as the specification of كَمْ.
يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ gives the visible circumstance while يَهْدِ is posed to them.
مَسَاكِنِهِمْ is governed by فِي with يَمْشُونَ.
ذَٰلِكَ is governed by فِي as the fronted predicate phrase under إِنَّ.
آيَاتٍ is the delayed governed noun of إِنَّ; the لَ before it is emphatic.
فِي ذَٰلِكَ supplies the fronted predicate of إِنَّ.
لَا negates يَسْمَعُونَ in the closing rhetorical question.
لَمْ governs يَرَوْا in the jussive rhetorical question.
أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ... فَنُخْرِجُ is the content clause governed by يَرَوْا.
The suffix نَا in أَنَّا is the governed noun of أَنَّ.
نَسُوقُ supplies the predicate content of أَنَّا.
ٱلْمَاءَ is the direct object of نَسُوقُ.
ٱلْأَرْضِ is governed by إِلَى as the destination of نَسُوقُ.
ٱلْجُرُزِ agrees with and describes ٱلْأَرْضِ.
فَ links نُخْرِجُ as the follow-on result of نَسُوقُ.
The suffix هِ in بِهِ is governed by بِ as the means used with نُخْرِجُ.
زَرْعًا is the direct object brought forth by نُخْرِجُ.
تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَامُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ is a descriptive clause for زَرْعًا.
The suffix هُ in مِنْهُ is governed by مِنْ as the source eaten from by تَأْكُلُ.
أَنْعَامُهُمْ is the overt subject of تَأْكُلُ.
أَنفُسُهُمْ is conjoined with أَنْعَامُهُمْ as another eater of the crop.
لَا negates يُبْصِرُونَ in the closing rhetorical question.
مَتَىٰ هَذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِنْ كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ is the full utterance governed by يَقُولُونَ.
مَتَىٰ is the interrogative temporal predicate for هَذَا.
ٱلْفَتْحُ is appositional clarification of هَذَا.
إِنْ governs كُنتُمْ in the conditional protasis.
صَادِقِينَ is the predicate of كُنتُمْ.
يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ ... وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ is the full quoted response to قُلْ.
يَوْمَ sets the time for لَا يَنفَعُ.
ٱلْفَتْحِ is the genitive complement of يَوْمَ.
ٱلَّذِينَ is the object not benefited by يَنفَعُ.
إِيمَانُهُمْ is the overt subject of يَنفَعُ.
وَلَا joins يُنظَرُونَ as the second negated assertion after لَا يَنفَعُ.
يُنظَرُونَ predicates the passive verbal assertion about هُمْ.
لَا negates يَنفَعُ in the quoted ruling.
كَفَرُوا completes ٱلَّذِينَ as its relative descriptive clause.
لَا negates يُنظَرُونَ in the second quoted assertion.
The suffix هُمْ in عَنْهُمْ is governed by عَنْ with أَعْرِضْ.
وَ coordinates ٱنتَظِرْ with أَعْرِضْ.
The suffix هُمْ in إِنَّهُم is the governed noun of إِنَّ.
مُّنتَظِرُونَ is the predicate of إِنَّهُم.
